methods.label: Find the favorable region
methods.sourceMethod: AoPS diamond-region geometric probability and AM-GM optimization, informed also by LIVE's fixed-x favorable lengths and explicit treatment of a=0. Triangle areas replace integration, and AM-GM replaces differentiation.

annotationRationale: Trigonometric identities and monotonicity produce a diamond-shaped event under independent uniform sampling. Area ratios and AM-GM give a complete high-school solution, including the degenerate endpoint. Completing the square would only replace the final bound on the same expression, so it is not presented as a distinct method.

classificationReview.areaCheck: Counting & Probability is appropriate because the central modeling step is a uniform area ratio.

review.questionCheck: Under the usual independent continuous uniform interpretation, P(0)=0, P(a)=a for 0<a≤1/2, and P(a)=2−a−1/(2a) for 1/2≤a≤1. The maximum is 2−√2 at a=1/√2, matching choice B. The degenerate endpoint and strict inequality are handled consistently; no figure conflict exists.
review.alternativeMethodCheck: No shared-bank methods are supplied. The AoPS diamond-area and AM-GM route is retained. LIVE's fixed-x lengths produce the same area formula; its integration and differentiation add no necessary accessible route. Completing a square would only replace the final bound on the same expression.
review.annotationCheck: Geometric probability and AM-GM are correctly assessed. The identity, reduction formulas and sine monotonicity are appropriate supporting concepts, and every immediate method ID is used.
review.areaCheck: Counting & Probability is appropriate because the central modeling step is a uniform area ratio.

methodReviews.mathCheck: The trigonometric reductions correctly give |y−1/2|<min(x,1−x). For a≤1/2 the favorable triangle has area a². For a≥1/2 the unfavorable area is 1/4+(a−1/2)², giving 2−a−1/(2a). AM-GM bounds this by 2−√2, with attainable equality at a=1/√2. This exceeds the first range's maximum 1/2. The zero-area boundary and a=0 are separately justified.
methodReviews.sourceMethodCheck: The claimed AoPS geometric-region and AM-GM basis is verified, while LIVE supports the favorable lengths and endpoint treatment. The prose independently derives the region and triangle areas, with correct source-informed-original attribution and no official MAA claim.
methodReviews.pedagogyCheck: The explanation makes the sampling model explicit, derives the straight boundaries rather than merely asserting them, and describes all triangle dimensions. The optimization states positivity, equality conditions and domain membership. A new diagram is unnecessary.
methodReviews.directNodeCheck: All five IDs are directly supported: uniform area probability, the Pythagorean identity, reduction formulas, sine monotonicity and AM-GM optimization. The degenerate a=0 case is correctly handled outside the positive-area probability formula.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The exact CN links for the four trigonometric and AM-GM topics fit their actual uses. Geometric probability has no supplied CN link.

nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: The immediate concepts precisely support the complete derivation. Neither calculus nor an unexplained advanced optimization technique is introduced.
